chunks.content: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4 on 2025-05-08 — the "Claude 4" family: Opus 4 the flagship ("Claude 4"), Sonnet 4 the fast workhorse. Pricing: Opus 4 at $15 / $75 per million tokens (input/output), Sonnet 4 at $3 / $15 — Sonnet priced as the developer-default coding model. The headline capability was agentic coding and computer use: Claude 4's "computer use 2.0" (browser control) was roughly twice as reliable as the 3.x generation's, and the launch was timed to the rise of Claude Code as the defining agentic-coding product of 2025. The 4.1 update (2025-06-18) improved coding and agentic reliability at the same prices; the naming ("4.1" rather than "4.5") followed a reported internal dispute about Anthropic's version-naming policy. The direct competitive context was the OpenAI o-series and the enterprise agentic-coding gold rush; Anthropic positioned Claude 4 as the safest and most reliable coding agent and reported record API usage. Driven by Claude Code adoption, Anthropic raised a large funding round in late September 2025 at a reported ~$183 billion valuation, cementing its position as the coding-agent leader.

prior_gap_texts: Anthropic released the Claude 4 family, comprising two models—Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4—on May 8, 2025 [Source: ev-1].

The decision to launch these as distinct tiers was driven by their different roles in the market: Opus 4 served as the flagship model with pricing of $15 per million input tokens and $75 per million output tokens, while Sonnet 4 acted as a "fast workhorse" and developer-default coding model priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens [Source: ev-1].

The launch signaled that Anthropic positioned itself as the leader in the agentic-coding market, specifically competing against OpenAI’s o-series during an enterprise gold rush for this technology [Source: ev-1].

By highlighting capabilities such as "computer use 2.0," which was roughly twice as reliable as the previous generation's browser control, Anthropic aimed to establish Claude 4 as the safest and most reliable coding agent available [Source: ev-1].

This strategic release coincided with the rise of Claude Code as a defining product of 2025 and contributed to record API usage, ultimately cementing Anthropic’s position in the sector ahead of its late September 2025 funding round at a reported ~$183 billion valuation [Source: ev-1].
